sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: Leader Value: Supporting Outcome-Based Delivery; Enabling Value Creation; Driving Organisational Value. Leader Ownership: Directing Work; Delegating Execution. Leader Trust: Control-Based Leadership; Limited Delegation.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: Leader Value behaviours may indicate an ambition for outcome-based delivery, while Leader Ownership or Trust behaviours may indicate direction and control over execution. This may create a contradiction between the outcomes leadership wants and the operating conditions it reinforces.

sourceEvaluation.notes: Candidate evidence is not yet an executable trigger. Confirm required, alternative, supporting, and contradictory behaviour combinations before defining conditions.
